thread:
carlos: Heads-up — Acme trial (SE acct) starts next Mon. Need quick sync on UAT integration deliverables and owners. Who's owning the webhook + auth flow?

maya: I can own the success criteria and integration QA. For webhooks we need HMAC + retry semantics documented.

ashwin: I can take the webhook endpoint. Quick note: infra needs a small redirect rule in staging (routing team) or the signed callback won't hit the handler. ETA for a PR: EOD Thu.

jen: For success criteria, customer cares about 99th pct latency < 400ms on short prompts and embeddings < 50ms for single-item. Also need an SSO test account and sample dataset. Can we provision those by Friday?

carlos: SSO test account — I can request from their IT, but need the SP metadata. Maya, can you send a minimal SAML checklist?

maya: Sending checklist in a sec. Also: we need to lock the model version for the trial (no drift). Recommend pin to rdx-small-v2-2025-04.

ashwin: noted on model pin. Regarding routing: if staging redirect can't be done by Friday, fallback plan is to use a tunnel (ngrok) for callbacks. Not ideal but workable for first week.

jen: For data sets — I'll prep a sanitized sample and share a Google Drive link by Thursday.

carlos: Code review/PRs: ashwin, can you ping eng-review when you open the webhook PR? We want someone from eng-runtime to eyeball KV caching impact.

ashwin: will do. tagging here: @deploy-bot please notify #eng-runtime when PR opens.

deploy-bot: Build status: staging-infra pipeline passed for branch feature/acme-webhook. No deploy yet (awaiting review).

maya: Also need an E2E smoke script for the SEs to run post-onboarding. I can draft it — will include prompts, expected tokens, and pass/fail heuristics.

carlos: Great. Can we compile a one-page runbook with owners and quick run steps by Friday? I'll present that in the kickoff.

jen: I'll own the runbook skeleton and add onboarding steps + test data links. Maya add the success criteria section once draft is up.

ashwin: PR will be up by EOD Thu and I'll add deployment notes (redirect vs tunnel). If routing team can't add rule, I'll set up tunnel and document switch steps.

maya: Action items summary:
- webhook endpoint owner: ashwin
- success criteria & QA owner: maya
- runbook skeleton + test data: jen
- SSO/SP metadata: carlos to collect from customer
- model pin: maya -> rdx-small-v2-2025-04
- fallback: ngrok tunnel (ashwin)

carlos: Perfect. I'll loop in solutions engagement lead + routing team after this thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
